title: The bWo makes Stevie Richards more than Raven’s sidekick
summary: Stevie Richards, the Blue Meanie and Nova turn a parody of WCW’s nWo into an ECW crowd favorite. The attention helps Richards move toward the world-title picture.

chapters.title: The Blue World Order debuts
chapters.result: Richards, Meanie and Nova appear as the bWo.
chapters.context: Their imitation of the nWo gives Raven’s supporting cast an identity of its own.

chapters.title: Richards reaches the contender match
chapters.result: Richards loses the three-way contender match to Funk, with Sandman also competing.
chapters.context: Sharing the major title-contender stage shows how far Richards has moved beyond comic sidekick status.
